name: Hubble USDH
oneLiner: USDH is Hubble Protocol's decentralized Solana stablecoin backed by overcollateralized CDP vaults and USDC held through its Peg Stability Module.
collateral: 94.2011% USDC in the Peg Stability Module and 5.7989% CDP-backed issuance; the reviewed CDP branch is split across mSOL, self-referential USDH and USDC inside the deprecated Kamino kUSDH-USDC vault, SOL, daoSOL, and residual collateral including impaired Sollet soBTC.
pegMechanism: Borrowers mint USDH against overcollateralized Solana vaults, while the Peg Stability Module supports zero-slippage USDH/USDC conversion and holds deposited USDC as direct backing

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hubble's official documentation identifies the January 2022 launch and describes USDH issuance through collateralized borrowing positions, the USDH liquidation vault, and peg-stability operations, supporting the CDP classification and launch month.

sources.label: Hubble official documentation - Why Use Hubble?

notices.title: Small float and dormant trading
notices.message: Hubble USDH has a small circulating float and dormant secondary trading. Hubble's documentation domain (docs.hubbleprotocol.io) no longer resolves, and Pharos has not verified borrowing or redemption on the remaining web app. The May 2026 cemetery entry is a historical assessment, not a current exclusion.
